item.title: WRE News: Mark Zuckerberg Joins the Billionaire Bunker With $200M Purchase
item.description: Miami, FL - February 10, 2026 - Mark Zuckerberg is the latest Silicon Valley titan trading California for Miami, snapping up a jaw-dropping waterfront estate on the ultra-exclusive Indian Creek.
